div.head: Ine 36.1
div.ab: Gif he ealdermon sy, þolige his scire, buton him se cyning arian wille.
Gif he ealdormon sie, ðolie his scire, buton him kyning arian wille.
Si aldermannus sit, perdat comitatum suum, nisi rex ei parcere uelit.
Gif he ealdormon sie, ðolie his scire, buton him kyning arian wille.
If he is an ealdorman, let him forfeit his shire, unless the king is willing to show him mercy.
If he is an ealdorman he shall forfeit his shire, unless the king is willing to pardon him.
If he is an ealdorman, he is to lose his office, unless the king wishes to pardon him.
Wenn er Ealdorman ist, verliere er sein Amt, es sei denn, (der) König wolle ihn begnadigen.
If he is an ealdorman, let him lose his office, unless (the) king is willing to pardon him.
